title: The blue line's due date is exact for Net 365 and day 31
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You start new terms due 365 days after the invoice date and on the 31st of the following month.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Today's date at {Location-A} is {Date-A}; {Date-B} is {Date-A} plus 365 days, and {Date-C} is day 31 of the month after {Date-A}, or that month's last day if it is shorter.
    For example: {Date-A} is Oct 23, {Date-B} is Oct 23 (of next year) and {Date-C} is Nov 30.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type 365 in the Days box.
  3. Click the Day box.
  4. Type 31 in the Day box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the blue line ends "An invoice dated {Date-A} is due {Date-B}."
  • Step 3: the "Due day of the following month" option is selected.
  • Step 4: the blue line ends "An invoice dated {Date-A} is due {Date-C}." (for example Oct 23 → Nov 30, because November has 30 days).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term), story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S3-R5: “While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term, using today's date as the example invoice date (S3-R16):”
  • S3-R16: “The example date in S3-R5 is today on the calendar of the location the user is working in; after a location switch it follows the new location.”
  • S7-R3: “When the following month is shorter than the term's day, the due date is that month's last day: day 31 invoiced in October is due Nov 30; day 30 or 31 invoiced in January is due Feb 28 (Feb 29 in a leap year); day 31 invoiced in March is due Apr 30.”
